proof.necessity_feasible: If f is a feasible selector then y=f(x) lies in A(x).
proof.necessity_stabilizer: For h in H_x, equivariance gives y=f(x)=f(h.x)=h.f(x)=h.y, so every h fixes y.
proof.representative_independence: If g1.x=g2.x then h=g2^{-1}g1 lies in H_x. If y is H_x-fixed, g1.y=g2.h.y=g2.y, so f(g.x)=g.y is independent of the representative.
proof.sufficiency_feasible: A(g.x)=g.A(x) and y in A(x) imply g.y in A(g.x).

scope_boundary: Uniqueness is only relative to the declared finite G-action, typed input/context and exact feasible relation A.
theorem: For one orbit G.x, a choice f(x)=y extends by f(g.x)=g.y to a well-defined deterministic G-equivariant feasible selector iff y in A(x) and H_x=Stab_G(x) is contained in Stab_G(y), equivalently y in E(x)=A(x) intersect Fix_Y(H_x).
